title: Inside AAON Season 2 Episode 09: Where Great Techs Are Made with Stan Horton
summary: Inside AAON explores the Technical Academy and how AAON equips technicians with the training they need to keep buildings running smoothly.
body_markdown:
In this episode of Inside AAON, Stan Horton, Senior Manager of AAON Technical Academy, joins us to talk about the essential role technicians play in our industry and how AAON supports the people who keep buildings running smoothly.


AAON continues to invest in the people behind our equipment, and our


[newly-renovated Technical Academy](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qq3820FFhMA&t=2s) leads the way. The premier training program for service technicians covers AAON HVAC equipment, controls, applications, and more. Each course prepares technicians for real-life situations they may experience when installing, servicing, and maintaining our equipment.


Tune in to hear how Stan and his team are shaping the next generation of technicians behind every AAON unit.


**HIGHLIGHTS FROM THE EPISODE:**


01:48– Skip Intro


02:15– Where it all Began


08:43–Recent Updates & Improvements


10:39– Why Tech Training Matters


18:38– How to Attend AAON Tech Academy


22:11– Looking Ahead
